rules.choose: Resume any owned unfinished claim first. Otherwise choose exactly the first unclaimed task with an empty current blocked_by list and a published exact proposal_base_sha. A completed Worker proposal may satisfy proposal-only dependencies when its exact HEAD has green Worker CI.
rules.atomic_reservation: Create the exact claim_branch and suggested feature branch from that task's published proposal_base_sha. If the claim already exists, treat it as a hard lock; the owning continuation resumes it and every other AI skips it.
rules.no_worker_numbers: Worker numbers are not assignment identities. Any authorized Worker AI uses the same shared pool.
rules.one_at_a_time: Exactly one claimed feature branch may be actively edited. After its exact-head CI is green and its pool entry is reconciled, immediately publish and claim exactly one next dependency-safe package instead of waiting for Trusted review.
rules.lease: Reservation lasts seven hours after the last verified push; the task remains in the pool.
rules.dependencies: For Worker proposal sequencing, a dependency is satisfied by either Trusted integration in worker/main or a completed Worker PR with green CI on its exact HEAD. This only authorizes stacked untrusted proposal work; it never marks the dependency integrated and never authorizes Trusted merge or deployment.
rules.final_authority: Never merge to Trusted and never deploy.
rules.resume_before_claim: Before looking for an unclaimed task, resume any package in recovery_queue in listed order. Existing own work is never skipped merely because its claim branch exists.
rules.self_reconcile: After a Worker PR has green CI on its exact final HEAD, the owning Worker updates its own package to worker_complete_awaiting_trusted_review with PR, HEAD and CI evidence. It may then update exactly one still-unclaimed dependent package with a deterministic proposal_base_branch/proposal_base_sha and clear only dependencies proven by exact green Worker CI or Trusted integration. It must never set integrated, release/delete claims, modify another active claim, merge to Trusted or deploy.
rules.claim_lock: A claim survives errors, chat loss, limits and Worker completion. It blocks every other AI until Trusted explicitly integrates, cancels or transfers it with checkpoint evidence.
rules.continue_after_interrupt: On any recoverable tool/model/chat interruption, fetch the same feature branch and continue from the verified remote HEAD. Do not abandon or duplicate work.
rules.proposal_stacking: A single completed dependency uses that dependency's exact green feature HEAD as proposal base. Multiple completed dependencies require an explicitly published Worker-only composition base with complete green CI before the next claim. Never guess or blind-merge a composition base.
rules.no_account_baselines: New work uses worker/main or an explicitly published exact green predecessor/composition HEAD. Retired numbered account baselines are not assignment sources.
rules.autonomous_continuation: After every green exact-head Worker PR, self-reconcile, prepare and validate any required dependency-safe composition base, then atomically claim and start the next eligible package without asking the user for another instruction or FCP number.
rules.connector_access: Use the connected GitHub plugin for repository writes. Missing terminal credentials or failed command-line git push is not a blocker unless a GitHub plugin write also fails for authorization.
rules.no_false_global_block: Re-evaluate every unclaimed package and proven green dependency after each completion. Do not report the whole pool blocked merely because the first candidate is blocked or because a composition base has not yet been prepared.
